text: params ggm_elicited object, returned elicit_prior. also inherits bgm_elicited. method planning method use, "DPIR" (default), "BFDA", "BSDA". One method runs per call. H, J Outer inner Monte Carlo replication counts. H draws prior (default 150), J datasets per draw (default 20). n Candidate sample sizes search . NULL (default) picks grid automatically refines bisection. threshold DPIR BFDA . Target threshold criterion must reach: DPIR ratio "DPIR", Bayes factor "BFDA". NULL (default) uses 1.0 DPIR 10.0 BFDA. BSDA uses measure_value instead. n_tol Search tolerance, observation units. search stops bracket reaches width. Default 1, .e. exact (increasing value speeds search may reduce accuracy). max_n Largest sample size considered. target met max_n, search stops reports non-convergence. Default 5000. target_probability DPIR : often ratio must reach threshold. Default 0.95. rho_quantile BFDA : edge plan around. Edges ordered magnitude partial correlation one quantile selected. Default 0.5, median edge. selected edge reported signed partial correlation. pow0, pow1 BFDA : often Bayes factor must give decisive evidence hypothesis true. BF01 Bayes factor edge absence, pow0 targets Pr(BF01 > threshold | H0), correctly excluding edge, pow1 targets Pr(BF01 < 1/threshold | H1), correctly detecting edge. default 0.8. nsim_bf BFDA : number Monte Carlo samples estimate Bayes factor sparse graphs. Default 1000. Ignored dense graphs, Bayes factor available closed form. measure, measure_value, target_pow BSDA : measure plan ("sen" "spe"), target value measure, target power achieve . Defaults "sen", 0.8, 0.8. range_lower BSDA : lower bound sample size search range. Default 2. control BSDA : list control parameters, returned   bsda_control. Default bsda_control(). #' @param ... Ignored, present consistency generic design().

title: Sample-size planning for a Gaussian graphical model — design.ggm_elicited
text: method targets criterion required frequency, criterion arguments differ: DPIR Targets data--prior information ratio. Uses     threshold (ratio surpass, default 1)     target_probability (often, default 0.95). BFDA Targets Bayes factor representative edge. Uses     threshold (Bayes factor value surpass, default 10), pow0/pow1     (target power hypothesis), rho_quantile (    edge plan around). BSDA Targets selection criterion (sensitivity specificity)     given power. Uses measure ("sen" "spe"),     measure_value (level reach, default 0.8), target_pow     (target power, default 0.8), range_lower (smallest n     searched), control (sampler fit settings; see     bsda_control). Requires posterior inclusion probabilities,     supplied pip ggm_parameters, sparse     graph. Arguments required method ignored. BFDA edge tested H0 : "edge absent" H1 : "edge present", Bayes factor reported throughout BF01, Bayes factor absence: BF01 > threshold excludes edge, BF01 < 1/threshold detects . reciprocal inclusion Bayes factor BF10. BSDA search proceeds two stages: coarse exploration locates region target power met, repeatedly fits probit model power curve, inverts n*, narrows grid, recommendation stabilizes. recommendation comes fitted curve rather direct threshold crossing, carries confidence interval, can fail two ways: identified = FALSE (fit established) converged = FALSE (loop hit max_iter without stabilizing). Cost grows H * J width search: criterion evaluated simulation every candidate n.

title: designbgm 0.3.0
text: New planning method "BSDA" (Bayesian structural design analysis) design(). recommends sample size edge selection reaches target sensitivity specificity given power, using probit inversion simulated power curve. ggm_parameters() gains pip argument (prior inclusion probabilities), supplied single probability matrix. Required BSDA carried elicit_prior(). bsda_control() helper control list user can specify: sampler, model-fit, search settings BSDA planning. validate() now supports BSDA plans, reporting achieved power recommended sample size confidence interval.

title: designbgm 0.3.0
text: print() methods ggm_parameters ggm_elicited now display prior inclusion probabilities (range) supplied.

title: designbgm 0.2.0
text: New exported function constrain_precision_to_graph(), projects precision matrix onto fixed undirected graph returns precision matrix constrained graph’s zero pattern (entries non-edges set zero). design.ggm_elicited() now includes nsim_bf argument controlling number Monte Carlo simulations used Bayes-factor computation sparse (G-Wishart) BFDA path. Defaults 1000L, matching underlying C++ default. Finally, value recorded returned design object’s call_info sparse BFDA designs. DPIR dense BFDA design routines now report timing information, 0.1.0 available sparse BFDA path. Durations returned design object: duration_bisection_global duration_bisection_pw DPIR, duration_h0 duration_h1 BFDA.
